output.summary: A cosmopolitan genus of macroscopic green algae ranging from the Arctic to the Antarctic, Prasiola occurs on land and in fresh and marine water. It forms single-cell-thick blades shaped like fans, ribbons or wedges; marine forms often grow side by side as dense green turf on rocks.
output.edibilityNote: Species are harvested for food, especially Prasiola japonica in Japan and Myanmar.
